system.description:
• Effect: Dismiss any animal, beast, plant, or vermin native to one of the Druid's Nature Lore regions.
  • Wisdom check, DC = 10 + total Levels of the creatures being dismissed
  • Each day the Druid can dismiss Levels worth of creatures equal to 10 + Wisdom modifier without penalty
  • Dismissed creatures flee and don't return until the Druid departs

activities.name: Dismiss Woodland Creatures
activities.text: Make a Wisdom check against DC 10 + the total Levels of native creatures to make them flee until you leave.
